# Bundled Formula Assets

The following upstream KaTeX browser stylesheet and font files are distributed unmodified for build-time rendered math. Version and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `manifest.json`.

| Distribution | Version | Upstream License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| KaTeX | 0.19.0 | MIT |

The `katex/0.19.0/` directory retains its upstream `package.json` and `LICENSE`. KaTeX retains its upstream copyright and MIT license; Autuswing's MIT license applies to its own code.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex
